title: Why it sucks being a Leeds United fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Leeds United fan!
It starts when you're five. You're in the third division. Your dad talks about Champions League nights. You think the Champions League is a video game.
Age nine. New owner. Six managers in two years. You stop learning their names. So does the owner.
Age thirteen. A legendary coach arrives. He sends a spy to watch the other team's training. He gets caught. So he gives a press conference... explaining how spying works. For an hour.
Age fifteen. Promoted! After sixteen years! Fans aren't allowed in the stadium. So the whole city parties outside it instead.
Age seventeen. Last day of the season. You survive! Safe! The next season... you don't.
That's the thing about being a Leeds fan. Everyone calls you "Dirty Leeds". You take it as a compliment.
Up. Down. Spied on. Sold out. Marching on together.
Tag a Leeds fan who's still marching. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
